subject: SOC 2 re-attestation: evidence handoff, retention split & audit burst request
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@acme-analytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com, secops@acme-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 7 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 re-attestation: evidence handoff and retention split?

Hi Mina,

We're kicking off our SOC 2 re-attestation for the Nov audit window and I wanted to confirm Redwood's proposed approach for two things that are blockers on our side: a) splitting audit logs/retention into a short-term live window and a longer-term archive, and b) temporary capacity/burst during the two-week evidence review window.

Specifically, Acme's audit team would like logs retained in a searchable live window of 90 days, with an immutable archive for three years. That will require us to map what you can provide as live vs archived artifacts (raw request/response logs, KV cache snapshots, model invocation metadata, and redaction markers). We also expect a heavier-than-normal token ingestion during the evidence pull — looking for a seat/burst increase for roughly 10–14 days.

Can you confirm:
- whether Redwood can provide an explicit split (90d live / 3y archive) under a retention amendment, and how that maps to the evidence bundle you hand off;
- what the mechanics are for the evidence handoff (S3/Drive staging, manifest format, hash checks); and
- a cost estimate for a temporary 20% seat/burst over baseline for a 14-day window, plus any implications for our contract language?

Procurement looped me on timing — our preferred audit window is 2025-11-10 through 2025-11-24. If we can get a draft amendment and a staging plan this week that would help our timelines.

Thanks,
Ellen
Security Program Manager
Acme Analytics

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Oct 2025 17:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation: evidence handoff and retention split?

Hi Ellen — thanks for the clear note and timeline. Looping in Kimberly and Ben for pricing/contract, and Lauren for the amendment language. Below is a pragmatic plan we can execute quickly: 

1) Retention split and artifacts
- We can support a 90-day "live" window with full indexing + short-term KV cache snapshots, and a 3-year immutable archive for raw logs and manifests.
- Evidence types we provide: request/response logs (redacted per agreed PII rules), model invocation metadata, KV cache snapshots (where applicable), service audit events, and SHA256 manifests for bundle integrity.

2) Evidence handoff mechanics
- Staging: S3 staging bucket (read-only access for your auditors) + a mirrored Drive folder for convenience.
- Manifest: XLSX/CSV manifest with artifact name, SHA256, timestamp, environment tag (prod/us-east-1), and retention tier.
- Transfer verification: checksum file + short runbook for your auditors.

Attachments: I attached an initial evidence_manifest_v1.xlsx and a draft retention_amendment_draft.pdf for your review.

3) Audit burst / capacity uplift
- Proposed temporary uplift: 20% seat increase for the two-week window (2025-11-10 -> 2025-11-24).
- Estimated cost delta (ballpark): $6,200 for the period (finalized by Sales).

Next steps
- Please confirm audit dates and whether the 90d/3y split covers your internal needs.
- Kimberly will follow up with a pricing amendment and PO/DocuSign pathway; Lauren will iterate on the retention amendment language.

If that plan looks good I can kick off the staging bucket and schedule a short evidence dry-run next week.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0127

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@acme-analytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com, secops@acme-analytics.com
Date: Wed, 8 Oct 2025 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation: evidence handoff and retention split?

Thanks Mina — that sounds promising.

A couple of follow-ups from our security and procurement leads: 
- Region: The audit will only accept US-resident logs for the primary evidence. Can the staging/manifest include an explicit region tag and confirm that US-only artifacts are segregated?
- Sample: SecOps asked for a small sample bundle (5–10 artifacts with manifests) we can ingest to validate mapping and the checksums. Could you provide that by Friday?
- Contract: Procurement needs a clear summary of the cost delta and the DocuSign route so we can align PO timing.

On dates — yes, 2025-11-10 -> 2025-11-24 is confirmed.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

We also expect a heavier-than-normal token ingestion during the evidence pull — looking for a seat/burst increase for roughly 10–14 days.

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@acme-analytics.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Oct 2025 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation: evidence handoff, retention split & audit burst request

Hi Ellen — copying final commercial details and next steps so procurement has a single thread to reference.

Summary (commercial):
- Temporary uplift: 20% seat increase for 14 days (2025-11-10 -> 2025-11-24) — estimated uplift fee: $6,200.
- Retention amendment: adds a 90-day live searchable tier + 3-year immutable archive. No changes to data residency beyond confirming US-only staging for Acme.
- Attachments: pricing_breakdown_Q4_v3.pdf (line-item cost) and retention_amendment_draft.pdf (legal redline).

Acceptable execution paths:
1) PO + signed amendment: Procurement issues PO for the uplift amount and countersigns the amendment via DocuSign.
2) Net-30 contract amendment: If you need a short payment window we can accept Net-30 on the uplift as long as the amendment is signed prior to the staging start date.

Action items for Acme:
- Confirm region tagging and acceptance of the 90d/3y split (SECOPS).
- Sign amendment or issue PO by 2025-10-27 to keep on schedule.
- Confirm the sample bundle criteria so we can hand over 5 artifacts by Friday.

Once we receive the signed amendment / PO, we will:
- Provision the staging S3 bucket and share access keys (read-only)
- Run the sample transfer and checksum validation with your SecOps
- Trigger the temporary seat bump on 2025-11-09 (one day before audit window).

If that works, Mina will coordinate the dry-run and I'll send the DocuSign link after the PO signal.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
